en.bdb: The abode of true Guru is the holy congregation ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham satigur saadhasa(n)gat vich vasai|

en.bdb: The true Guru is the transcendent perfect Brahm and resides in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਸਹਜ ਵਿਗਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat aaraadheeaai bhai bhagat bhai sahaj vigasai|

en.bdb: By absorbing the consciousness in the Word He is adored, and cherishing love, devotion and His awe He spontaneously blooms in the heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੋਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭੋਗੁ ਵਿਣਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: naa oh marai na sog hoi dhe(n)dhaa rahai na bhog vinasai|

en.bdb: He never dies nor becomes sorrowful. He always goes on bestowing, and his bounties are never exhausted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: guroo samaanaa aakheeaai saadhasa(n)gat abinaasee hasai|

en.bdb: People say that the Guru has passed away but the holy congregation smilingly accepts Him as indestructible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੇਵੀਂ ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੀੜੀ ਕੋ ਦਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: chhevee(n) peeRhee guroo dhee gursikhaa(n) peeRee ko dhasai|

en.bdb: Guru (Hargobind) is the sixth generation of Gurus but who can tell about the generations of the Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉਂ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਸਰਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: sach naau(n) sach dharasano sachakha(n)dd satisa(n)g sarasai|

en.bdb: The concepts of true name, true glimpse, and the true abode get their explanation only in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa saadhasa(n)g bhagat vachhal paaras parasai|

en.bdb: The cup of love is quaffed in the holy congregation and there only the touch of the philosopher's stone (Lord), loving to devotees is received.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar hoi akaal ajonee jasai|

en.bdb: In the holy congregation, the formless one assumes form and there only the unborn, timeless
Being is eulogized. The truth only prevails there and everyone is tested on the touchstone of truth there.
